violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION HAD EXPIRED CERTIFICATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM WITH VALID CERTIFICATION ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. EMPLOYEE WITH EXPIRED CERTIFICATE WILL RENEW THEIR CERTIFICATION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. BUFFALO WING FACTORY (Inspection Date: 08/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN NEAR THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 88F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO PIC. PIC WILL ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK IS REPAIRED WITHIN 10 DAYS AND SEND PROOF OF CORRECTION TO EHS.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Pressure Meets Facility Demands
violations.observation: Hot water under insufficient or inadequate pressure was found to serve the following equipment: HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN, NEAR THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, equipment, and nonfood equipment that are required to use water. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE PRESSURE IS REPAIRED AND PROOF OF CORRECTION IS SHARED WITH EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS. BUFFALO WING FACTORY (Inspection Date: 03/05/2025) Page 2 of 3
